name: Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
note: The Russian Federation continued the USSR's membership of the United Nations and its Security Council seat from 24 December 1991.

name: Yugoslavia
note: The Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia until 1992; the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (admitted in 2000) until it became Serbia and Montenegro in 2003.

name: Serbia and Montenegro
note: Serbia continued the membership from 3 June 2006; Montenegro was admitted separately.

name: State of Palestine
note: A non-member observer State of the United Nations since 29 November 2012.

name: Holy See
note: A non-member observer State of the United Nations.

name: Kosovo
note: Not a member of the United Nations. Named as in the records.
